title: Network Watcher Pricing Details - Azure Cloud Computing
metaDescription: Learn the pricing details of Azure Network Watcher. Network Watcher can be used to monitor and diagnose the operation status and performance of networks.
metaKeywords: Azure Network Watcher, Network, Virtual Network

Feature Free Units Included Price
Network flow logs collected (NSG flow logs) 1 5 GB per month ￥5.09 per GB
Virtual network flow logs collected N/A ￥3.18 per GB
Network Diagnostic Tools 2 1,000 checks per month ￥10.00/1,000 per check
Connection Monitor 10 tests per month 0-10 tests - Included
10-240,010 tests - ￥3.054 per test per month
240,010-750,010 tests - ￥1.017 per test per month
750,010-1,000,010 tests - ￥0.509 per test per month
1,000,010+ tests - ￥0.203 per test per month
Traffic Analytics ‐ ‐ Accelerated processing at 10-min intervals: ￥35.61 per GB-processed
Standard processing at 60-min intervals: ￥23.405 per GB-processed
1 Network log is stored in the Storage account, and 1-day to 365-day retention policies are provided. If you do not configure a retention policy, the logs will be retained all the time. Relevant fees will be charged for Storage, Log Analytics and Event Hubs.

2 The billing for the diagnostic tools and topological features of Network Watcher is based on the number of network diagnosis triggered by Azure portal, PowerShell, CLI or Rest.

3 Data Processing at 10-min interval full pricing will be effective on January 1 st , 2020.

4 Traffic Analytics feature is billed for log data processed by the service and for the resulting data ingested into the Azure Log Analytics service. Corresponding charges apply for logs ingested to the Azure Log Analytics service.

commonSections.content:
Network Watcher

Network performance monitoring and diagnostics solution

Network Watcher can be used to monitor and diagnose the operation status and performance of the network. For example, the diagnose and visualization tools of Network Watcher can help capture data packages on a Virtual Machine and confirm whether to accept or refuse certain IP traffic. They can also mark and identify locations to which data packages will be routed from a Virtual Machine and deeply understand the whole network topology.

Pricing Details

Support & SLA

If you have any questions or need help, please visit Azure Support and select self-help service or any other method to contact us for support.

We guarantee that at least 99.9% of the time, network diagnostic tools can successfully perform and return responses. To learn more about the details of our Service Level Agreement, please visit the Service Level Agreements page.
